_about: The Kalevala, the Finnish epic compiled by Elias Lönnrot, in John Martin Crawford's translation (1888), as the relay asked: the complete Gutenberg text, translator in the title. US public domain. W. F. Kirby's translation (1907, Everyman's Library, 2 vols.) was added later as a second witness. Widened at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: Lane D chooses its own batches; Adam may veto).

kalevala-crawford: Kalevala: The Epic Poem of Finland, tr. John Martin Crawford (1888)
kalevala-kirby-1: Kalevala, The Land of the Heroes, tr. W. F. Kirby (1907), vol. 1
kalevala-kirby-2: Kalevala, The Land of the Heroes, tr. W. F. Kirby (1907), vol. 2

_excluded.kalevala-duplicates: Crawford's Kalevala volumes 1 and 2 (PG 5184, 5185): the same text as the complete file
